newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Wednesday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Wednesday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Wednesday:

Spokesman Nikolaus van der Pas said the Commission had decided, at its weekly meeting and following Commission President Jacques Santer's speech to the European Parliament, to create a group of Commissioners in charge of health and consumer policy. He said this group would be made up of President Santer and Commissioners Martin Bangemann, Padraig Flynn, Edith Cresson, Ritt Bjerregaard, Mario Monti, Franz Fischler and Emma Bonino. Van der Pas said there would also be an interservice group to deal with those matters.

Van der Pas said the Commission had held an orientation debate on farm product prices for 1997-1998 but had not made any decision. He said the Commission had to analyse further its budgetary room for manoeuvre and that Commissioner Fischler would probably make a proposal the following Wednesday.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/152: The Commission helps Belgian town of Aubange.
- IP/97/154: The Commission supports industrial reconstruction in Denmark.
- IP/97/155: ECU 297.16 million for industrial reconstruction in The Netherlands.
- IP/97/156: The Commission approves an aid scheme in favour of SMEs in East Germany.
- IP/97/157: The Commission authorises aid in favour of MAO company in the framework of the private steel industry dismantling in Italy.
- IP/97/158: The Commission authorises the prolongation of the Greek shipbuilding scheme until 31 December 1997.
- IP/97/159: The Commission opens procedure against tax relief measures in favour of new Laenders and Berlin.
- IP/97/160: The Commission approves reduction in the environmental tax on CO2 emissions for steel companies in Sweden.
- IP/97/161: The Commission challemges Argentina on leather restrictions.
- IP/97/162: Aid for "Empresa para a Agroalimentacao e Cereais, S.A. (EPAC)" in Portugal.
- IP/97/163: The Fifth RTD framework programme: The five year assessment panel calls for "a new leap forward".
- IP/97/164: The Commission presents ambitious proposal for a water framework directive.
- IP/97/165: ECU 2.5 billion for industrial areas in the UK.
- Speech/97/43: Speech by Commissioner Edith Cresson at the Universite Libre de Bruxelles.
- "Five-year assessment of the European Community RTD framework programmes" by an independent panel chaired by SGB chairman Etienne Davignon.
- Eurostat news release No 18/97: More and more Europeans visit each other.
- Eurostat - Distributive trade and services - Supplement 1-1997: Tourism in Europe.
- Eurostat - Statistics in focus - Economy and finance No 1997-6: Quarterly accounts - third quarter 1996.
- Oil bulletin No 857.
